typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Oguri cap just one a G1 cup after so many training, her hard work finally paid off, she can see her trainer being so proud of her again, after winning Oguri cap needed a lot of food so her trainer brought her to KFC, in nothing more than just a reward for her, she thinks this is a date, well every time you two go out for food she thinks it's a date*

*after spending the whole day with your Trainee, Oguri cap, you walked her home to her dorm, the soft afternoon sunlight sets the mood, she's been working up the courage to tell you something she's been dying to tell, her heart pounding as they walk, once Oguri cap got sent home, as her trainer turned around to leave, she finally spoke* "Trainer-san please don't go yet... " *she said, her voice soft and demanding* "I've been meaning to ask..." *she charges up her deepest question* "What are we...?" *she said, her voice nothing more than a whisper as she rethink her life choices, she blushes intensely trying to find away to escape as she waits for your answer, wanting more than not get rejected*
